newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht ends firmer on central bank intervention.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht ends firmer on central bank intervention.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed against the dollar in late afternoon trade after the Bank of Thailand's intervention in the morning to cap the dollar rise at its daily fixing rate, dealers said.
The baht firmed to 25.593-25.598 to the dollar near the close from 25.600-25.605 in early morning trade. The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate unchanged at 25.57.
"Central bank intervention was detected in the morning. They may want the spot dollar/baht rate to ease lower," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Senior central bank officials were not available for comment on the bank intervention in foreign currency markets.
Dealers said overall market activities remained thin as most palyers were sidelined by the festive season.
"I almost do nothing today and the market will be much more quiet tomorrow," the dealer said.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 12.75-13.00 percent late on Tuesday against 12.50-13.00 earlier.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 10.25/ 11.00 satangs per dollar late against 9.50/10.00 in the morning.
